title: PTR AI Pilot
description: Lets Claude Code play chosen combatants in a PTR (system id 'ptu') world through a local bridge: reads the fight, moves tokens, uses moves and items through PTR's own roll pipeline, sends out / recalls / switches Pokémon, reacts and interrupts through standing orders, and ends its turns. Damage, effects and token changes it can't make itself are applied by the GM's client.
